Chapter 9. Running Agentic Applications in Production生产级智能体应用

In Chapter 8 we explored architectural patterns for AI-driven applications and introduced agentic workflows at the conceptual level. Now we shift from architecture to the practical challenges of running these systems in production. Because the AI landscape in 2026 still evolves so rapidly, technical details can become obsolete within months. Rather than cataloging frameworks that may vanish, we concentrate on operational patterns that endure across tools and standards. Our goal is to equip you with guidance you can apply regardless of the framework you choose.

第 8 章我们探讨了 AI 驱动应用的架构模式，并在概念层面介绍了智能体工作流。现在我们从架构转向在生产环境运行这些系统的实际挑战。由于 2026 年的 AI 格局仍在飞速演变，技术细节可能几个月内就过时。与其罗列那些可能消失的框架，不如专注于跨工具、跨标准而长存的运维模式。我们的目标是给你一套无论选哪个框架都能用上的指导。

This chapter addresses three core challenges for running agentic applications on Kubernetes:

本章讨论在 Kubernetes 上运行智能体应用的三大核心挑战：

  • Security: Agents interact with external tools and data sources, often on behalf of users. You need robust identity management, authentication patterns, and authorization controls that preserve user context while allowing agents to operate autonomously.智能体常常代表用户与外部工具和数据源交互。你需要健壮的身份管理、认证模式和授权控制，在让智能体自主运行的同时保留用户上下文。
  • Agent coordination: Multiagent systems require standardized communication protocols. Agents must discover each other's capabilities, delegate tasks, and track progress across service boundaries.多智能体系统需要标准化的通信协议。智能体必须能发现彼此的能力、委派任务，并跨服务边界跟踪进度。
  • State management: Unlike stateless REST APIs, agents maintain conversational context across multiple turns. Production deployments require persistent storage patterns that survive pod restarts and support horizontal scaling.与无状态的 REST API 不同，智能体会跨多轮对话维护会话上下文。生产部署需要能在 pod 重启后存活、并支持水平扩缩的持久化存储模式。

This chapter covers two protocols that emerged as de facto standards in late 2024 when it comes to agent communication. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes agent-to-tool communication, while Agent-to-Agent (A2A) standardizes inter-agent coordination. These are not theoretical specs created by an official standards body; nevertheless, industry leaders like OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, AWS, and the open source community have converged on them. The Agentic AI Foundation emerged in 2025 to provide a neutral home for these standardization efforts (see the following sidebar).

本章介绍两个在 2024 年末成为智能体通信事实上标准的协议。模型上下文协议（MCP）标准化了“智能体到工具”的通信，而 Agent-to-Agent（A2A）标准化了“智能体之间”的协调。它们并非由某个官方标准组织制定的理论规范；尽管如此，OpenAI、Google、Microsoft、AWS 等业界领军者以及开源社区已经汇聚到这两个协议上。Agentic AI Foundation 于 2025 年成立，为这些标准化工作提供中立的家园（见随后的边栏）。

Sidebar: The Agentic AI Foundation

The Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) is a Linux Foundation project launched in 2025 to develop open standards for agentic AI systems. The eight founding platinum members are AWS, Anthropic, Block, Bloomberg, Cloudflare, Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI.

The foundation's stated vision is to provide “a neutral, open foundation to ensure this critical capability evolves transparently, collaboratively, and in ways that advance the adoption of leading open source AI projects.”

The foundation launched with three initial projects:

  • Model Context Protocol (MCP): An open protocol that defines how LLM applications connect to external data sources and tools. Agents use MCP to discover available functions through JSON schema definitions and invoke them using a standard JSON-RPC message format.一个开放协议，定义 LLM 应用如何连接外部数据源和工具。智能体通过 JSON schema 定义发现可用函数，并用标准 JSON-RPC 消息格式调用它们。
  • goose: An open source AI agent that can install packages, run shell commands, modify files, and execute tests. Unlike code completion tools that suggest edits, goose performs these operations directly and works with any LLM backend.一个开源 AI 智能体，能安装软件包、运行 shell 命令、修改文件并执行测试。与只给出编辑建议的代码补全工具不同，goose 直接执行这些操作，可搭配任意 LLM 后端。
  • AGENTS.md: A file format specification for documenting how AI coding agents should interact with a codebase. Projects use AGENTS.md files to describe their directory structure, build processes, testing conventions, and preferred workflows.一种文件格式规范，用于记录 AI 编码智能体应如何与代码库交互。各项目用 AGENTS.md 文件描述目录结构、构建流程、测试约定和偏好的工作流。

The foundation operates under Linux Foundation governance, which means technical decisions go through steering committees rather than being controlled by any single company. New projects and member organizations can join through the standard Linux Foundation contribution process.

The AAIF is very young (only months old at the time of writing). However, the participation of eight major technology companies suggests it will likely play a significant role in how agentic AI standards develop over the next few years.

Agentic AI Foundation（AAIF）是 Linux Foundation 于 2025 年启动的项目，旨在为智能体 AI 系统制定开放标准；八家创始白金成员为 AWS、Anthropic、Block、Bloomberg、Cloudflare、Google、Microsoft 和 OpenAI。基金会愿景是“提供一个中立、开放的基础，确保这一关键能力以透明、协作的方式演进，并推动领先开源 AI 项目的采用”。它以三个初始项目起步：MCP、goose、AGENTS.md。基金会按 Linux Foundation 治理，技术决策由指导委员会而非某家公司控制。AAIF 很年轻（成书时仅数月），但八家科技巨头的参与预示它将在未来几年的智能体 AI 标准制定中扮演重要角色。

Let's start by exploring the Model Context Protocol, which gives agents a standardized way to connect to the tools and data sources they need to get work done.

我们先来探索模型上下文协议，它为智能体提供了一种标准化方式，去连接完成工作所需的工具和数据源。

The Model Context Protocol
模型上下文协议

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open protocol that allows AI-driven agents to connect with external tools, data sources and services in a consistent, structured way. Introduced by Anthropic in late 2024 as a “USB-C for AI applications,” MCP quickly became the de facto standard for agent-tool interoperability because it solves the integration pain points of early tool calling approaches. Before MCP, frameworks used ad hoc API calls, proprietary plug-ins, and M x N integrations that did not scale; passing context between tools was brittle and error-prone. MCP draws inspiration from the Language Server Protocol (LSP) by replacing this web of custom integrations with a clean M + N architecture: any MCP-compatible agent can invoke any MCP-exposed tool. Tools are described with names, descriptions, and input schemas in metadata so the LLM can decide when to use them. Think of an MCP server as a collection of functions, similar to how an operating system provides system calls or a programming language offers a standard library. This simplification is illustrated in Figure 9-1.

模型上下文协议（MCP）是一个开放协议，让 AI 驱动的智能体以一致、结构化的方式连接外部工具、数据源和服务。MCP 由 Anthropic 于 2024 年末推出，号称“AI 应用的 USB-C”，很快成为智能体与工具互操作的事实标准，因为它解决了早期工具调用方式的集成痛点。在 MCP 之前，各框架使用临时 API 调用、专有插件和无法扩展的 M×N 集成；在工具之间传递上下文既脆弱又易错。MCP 借鉴了语言服务器协议（LSP）的思路，用干净的 M+N 架构取代这张定制集成之网：任何兼容 MCP 的智能体都能调用任何以 MCP 暴露的工具。工具通过元数据中的名称、描述和输入 schema 来描述，让 LLM 能决定何时使用它们。可以把 MCP 服务器想象成一组函数的集合，类似操作系统提供系统调用、编程语言提供标准库。图 9-1 展示了这种简化。

In essence, MCP provides a common language for AI agents and tools, allowing each to evolve independently while remaining interoperable.

本质上，MCP 为 AI 智能体和工具提供了一种共同语言，让双方可以独立演进，同时保持互操作。

A typical interaction might proceed as follows (illustrated in Figure 9-2): an AI assistant receives a user query, recognizes that it needs external information, and queries an MCP server for its tool list. It selects and then invokes an appropriate tool. The MCP server executes the action and returns the result, which the agent uses to compose its final answer for the user.

一次典型的交互可能如下（见图 9-2）：AI 助手收到用户查询，意识到需要外部信息，便向 MCP 服务器查询其工具列表。它选择并调用一个合适的工具。MCP 服务器执行该动作并返回结果，智能体据此为用户组织最终答案。

原书第 341 页

In this flow, the agent's LLM constructs a sequence of tool calls by selecting appropriate tools and supplying them with arguments, guided by the provided tool descriptions and metadata. For example, if the user asks, “What's the weather in Paris, and could you email me the forecast?” the agent might call a weather_lookup tool on a weather MCP server with the location “Paris” as argument, then call an email_send tool on an email MCP server with the forecast data. MCP ensures that these calls are made in a structured, traceable way rather than via brittle prompt text.

在这个流程中，智能体的 LLM 在工具描述和元数据的指引下，选择合适的工具并附上参数，构造出一串工具调用。例如，如果用户问：“巴黎天气怎么样？能把预报发邮件给我吗？”智能体可能先在天气 MCP 服务器上调用 weather_lookup 工具，参数为地点“巴黎”，再在邮件 MCP 服务器上调用 email_send 工具，附上预报数据。MCP 保证这些调用以结构化、可追踪的方式进行，而不是靠脆弱的提示词文本。

An MCP server is essentially a microservice exposing one or more tools to AI agents via the MCP protocol. In Kubernetes, you typically run each MCP server as a deployment, containerized with the necessary runtime. For example, if you want to offer a PostgreSQL query tool to your AI agents, you could deploy the official Postgres MCP server container and configure it with the database connection string as an environment variable or a secret.

MCP 服务器本质上就是一个微服务，通过 MCP 协议向 AI 智能体暴露一个或多个工具。在 Kubernetes 上，你通常把每个 MCP 服务器作为一个 deployment 运行，用所需运行时打成容器。例如，如果你想给 AI 智能体提供 PostgreSQL 查询工具，可以部署官方的 Postgres MCP 服务器容器，并把数据库连接串作为环境变量或 Secret 配置进去。

Each MCP server can be scaled horizontally behind a Kubernetes service if it needs to handle concurrent requests from many agents. While the MCP protocol maintains session state for ongoing conversations, most MCP server implementations externalize this state to databases or caches, making individual server instances stateless for request handling. This allows you to leverage the usual Kubernetes scaling and scheduling strategies. Define resource requests and limits for each server, and use a Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) if the load is variable.

如果需要应对来自大量智能体的并发请求，每个 MCP 服务器都可以在 Kubernetes Service 后面水平扩缩。虽然 MCP 协议为进行中的会话维护会话状态，但大多数 MCP 服务器实现把这种状态外置到数据库或缓存中，使单个服务器实例在处理请求时是无状态的。这样你就能沿用 Kubernetes 常规的扩缩与调度策略。为每个服务器定义资源 request 和 limit；如果负载波动，再用 Horizontal Pod Autoscaler（HPA）。

It's worth considering co-location in some cases. If an MCP server is tightly coupled to the agent's data, like a filesystem tool that should operate on the same files the agent sees, you might deploy it as a sidecar container in the same pod as the agent. This ensures low-latency local calls and shared storage volumes. The trade-off is resource duplication and coupled lifecycles, a sidecar per agent pod versus one shared service, so evaluate based on your usage patterns.

在某些情况下值得考虑就近部署。如果某个 MCP 服务器与智能体的数据紧耦合——比如一个文件系统工具，应当操作智能体所看到的同一批文件——你可以把它作为 sidecar 容器部署在与智能体同一个 pod 里。这样能保证低延迟的本地调用和共享存储卷。代价是资源重复和生命周期耦合：每个智能体 pod 一个 sidecar，而不是一个共享服务，因此要根据使用模式权衡。

If you have many MCP servers, managing and discovering their endpoint URLs can become cumbersome. One pattern is to use a service registry or naming conventions. Since MCP servers self-describe their tools, an agent could theoretically query a central directory to find a tool it needs. In practice, many teams group related tools into a single MCP server to reduce the number of services. This pattern works only to a certain degree as the number of functions that an agent can consider is limited.

如果 MCP 服务器很多，管理和发现它们的端点 URL 会变得繁琐。一种做法是使用服务注册表或命名约定。由于 MCP 服务器会自描述其工具，理论上智能体可以查询一个中心目录来找到它需要的工具。实际中，许多团队把相关工具归到同一个 MCP 服务器里，以减少服务数量。但这种模式只能在一定程度上奏效，因为智能体能够考虑的函数数量是有限的。

原书第 342 页

More advanced tool selection techniques are emerging, such as RAG-based similarity search for appropriate tools, or programmatic tool discovery where agents write code to navigate a filesystem of tool definitions and load only the specific tools needed for a task.

更高级的工具选择技术正在涌现，比如基于 RAG 的相似度搜索来挑选合适的工具；又如程序化工具发现——智能体编写代码来遍历一个存放工具定义的文件系统，只加载完成任务所需的特定工具。

MCP Security
MCP 安全

When an AI agent calls an MCP tool that reads customer records, posts to Slack, or queries a database, a fundamental question surfaces: whose identity should the upstream API see? Should it see the end user who triggered the agent, the agent's own service account, or something else entirely?

当 AI 智能体调用一个读取客户记录、向 Slack 发帖或查询数据库的 MCP 工具时，一个根本问题浮现出来：上游 API 应该看到谁的身份？是触发智能体的最终用户，还是智能体自己的服务账号，抑或完全是别的什么？

In a traditional microservices architecture, service-to-service authorization is well understood. You might use mutual TLS with a service mesh, OAuth2 client credentials flow, or API keys scoped to specific services. Identity propagation patterns like token relay or the ambassador pattern help thread user context through multiple hops.

在传统微服务架构中，服务间授权已经很成熟。你可以用服务网格的双向 TLS、OAuth2 客户端凭据流，或限定到特定服务的 API key。像令牌中继（token relay）或大使（ambassador）模式这样的身份传播模式，能帮助把用户上下文穿过多跳链路。

However, agentic architectures bring additional challenges to the table.

然而，智能体架构带来了额外的挑战。

First, they introduce nondeterminism. Unlike a deterministic microservice, an agent's behavior is shaped by the LLM's reasoning, which means you cannot predict exactly which tools it will call or in what order. Traditional authorization policies that grant “Service A can call endpoint B” do not translate cleanly when Service A is an agent that might call 10 different tools based on a user prompt.

首先，它们引入了非确定性。与确定性的微服务不同，智能体的行为由 LLM 的推理塑造，这意味着你无法确切预测它会调用哪些工具、以什么顺序调用。传统那种授予“服务 A 可以调用端点 B”的授权策略，在服务 A 是一个可能根据用户提示调用 10 种不同工具的智能体时，并不能干净地平移过来。

Second, they create identity ambiguity. When an agent calls a tool on behalf of a user, should the upstream API see the user's identity to enforce per-user permissions and quotas, or should it see the agent's identity to track agent actions and enforce agent-level rate limits? The answer depends on your compliance requirements, but the question itself is harder to answer than in traditional flows.

其次，它们造成了身份模糊。当智能体代表用户调用工具时，上游 API 应该看到用户身份以执行按用户的权限和配额，还是看到智能体身份以追踪智能体行为、执行智能体级别的限流？答案取决于你的合规要求，但这个问题本身就比传统流程更难回答。

These challenges force you to make explicit choices about identity propagation that were implicit or automatic in simpler architectures. The four approaches we describe next represent different points on the trade-off curve among security, operational simplicity, and integration with existing infrastructure:

这些挑战迫使你对身份传播做出显式选择，而在更简单的架构里这些选择是隐式或自动的。我们接下来介绍的四种方案，代表了在安全性、运维简洁性和与现有基础设施集成这三者权衡曲线上的不同点：

  • Agent Impersonation (Token Passthrough): The agent forwards the user's access token to MCP servers and upstream APIs, preserving user identity for RBAC and audit logging.智能体把用户的访问令牌转发给 MCP 服务器和上游 API，保留用户身份以用于 RBAC 和审计日志。
  • Service Account Delegation: Kubernetes ServiceAccount tokens authenticate communication between agent, MCP server, and upstream APIs within a cluster.在集群内，用 Kubernetes ServiceAccount 令牌对智能体、MCP 服务器和上游 API 之间的通信进行认证。
  • Delegated Identity via OAuth2 Token Exchange: Token exchange (RFC 8693) creates credentials carrying both user identity and agent identity, combining attribution with service-level visibility.令牌交换（RFC 8693）生成同时携带用户身份和智能体身份的凭据，把归属追溯与服务级可见性结合起来。
  • Mutual TLS with SPIFFE/SPIRE: Cryptographically bound workload identities and short-lived certificates enable zero-trust authentication without stealable tokens.以密码学方式绑定的工作负载身份和短生命周期证书，实现无可窃取令牌的零信任认证。

Footnote 1: Those patterns have been inspired by and complement the great work of Christian Posta who describes similar patterns in his article “MCP Authorization Patterns for Upstream API Calls”.脚注 1：这些模式借鉴并补充了 Christian Posta 的出色工作，他在文章《MCP Authorization Patterns for Upstream API Calls》中描述了类似模式。

原书第 343 页

Let's start with the most straightforward approach: passing the user's token through the entire call chain.

我们从最直接的方案开始：把用户令牌透传过整条调用链。

Agent Impersonation (Token Passthrough)
Agent 模拟（令牌透传）

To propagate user identity, the agent represents or impersonates the user for any MCP interactions. The advantage of impersonation is that it preserves your existing RBAC infrastructure without modification. Your audit logs naturally capture which end user accessed which data, satisfying compliance requirements in one stroke. You can also enforce per-user quotas and rate limits, preventing a single user from exhausting shared resources.

为了传播用户身份，智能体在任何 MCP 交互中都代表（即模拟）用户。模拟的好处是无需改动就能保留你现有的 RBAC 基础设施。你的审计日志自然记录了哪个最终用户访问了哪份数据，一举满足合规要求。你还能执行按用户的配额和限流，防止单个用户耗尽共享资源。

In the agent impersonation pattern, the MCP server receives the end user's credentials from the agent runtime and uses them directly when calling upstream APIs. The upstream service sees the request as coming from the user, not from the agent. This is conceptually similar to the OAuth2 token passthrough pattern: the agent runtime passes the user's access token to the MCP server, which includes it in the Authorization header when calling the upstream API.

在智能体模拟模式中，MCP 服务器从智能体运行时收到最终用户的凭据，并在调用上游 API 时直接使用。上游服务看到的请求仿佛来自用户，而非智能体。这在概念上类似于 OAuth2 令牌透传模式：智能体运行时把用户的访问令牌传给 MCP 服务器，后者在调用上游 API 时把它放进 Authorization 头。

Consider Nurse Alice querying patient records through a medical assistant agent. The nurse authenticates to the agent runtime via OpenID Connect, obtaining an access token. When the nurse asks, “Show me lab results for patient 4711,” the agent runtime forwards the nurse's token to the MCP server along with the tool request. The MCP server then calls the hospital's patient records API with Alice's token in the Authorization header. The patient records API enforces its existing user-level permissions—checking whether this specific nurse is allowed to read records for patient 4711—and the audit log shows that Nurse Alice accessed patient 4711's lab results, not just that “the agent” accessed them.

以护士 Alice 通过医疗助手智能体查询病历为例。护士通过 OpenID Connect 向智能体运行时认证，获得一个访问令牌。当护士问“给我看 4711 号病人的化验结果”时，智能体运行时把护士的令牌连同工具请求一起转发给 MCP 服务器。MCP 服务器随后在 Authorization 头中带上 Alice 的令牌，调用医院的病历 API。病历 API 执行其既有的用户级权限——检查这位护士是否被允许读取 4711 号病人的记录——审计日志显示是护士 Alice 访问了 4711 号病人的化验结果，而不只是“智能体”访问了它们。

The pattern does introduce operational complexity around token lifetimes. User access tokens typically expire within minutes to hours, and if your agent's task runs longer than the token's lifetime, calls will fail unless you implement refresh logic. You also face scope explosion. The user's token must be valid for every upstream API the agent might call, which often means granting users broad OAuth scopes that violate the principle of least privilege. If your patient assistant agent might call the lab API, pharmacy API, and scheduling API, the nurse's token needs scopes for all three systems, even if this particular query touches just one.

这种模式确实在令牌生命周期上引入了运维复杂度。用户访问令牌通常在几分钟到几小时内过期，如果智能体任务跑得比令牌寿命还长，调用就会失败——除非你实现刷新逻辑。你还会面临 scope 膨胀。用户令牌必须对智能体可能调用的每个上游 API 都有效，这往往意味着授予用户过宽的 OAuth scope，违反最小权限原则。如果你的病人助手智能体可能调用化验 API、药房 API 和排班 API，那么护士的令牌需要具备这三个系统的 scope，哪怕这次查询只涉及其中一个。

原书第 344 页

There is also a credential theft risk. If the MCP server is compromised, an attacker can exfiltrate and replay user tokens to access any resource the user can access. Defense requires short token lifetimes, strong mTLS between services, and runtime security within the pod.

此外还有凭据被盗的风险。如果 MCP 服务器被攻破，攻击者就能窃取并重放用户令牌，访问用户能访问的任何资源。防御需要短令牌生命周期、服务间强 mTLS，以及 pod 内的运行时安全。

On Kubernetes, this pattern often involves an ingress controller that authenticates the user and injects the access token into a header. You might use Traefik, NGINX with oauth2-proxy, or Istio with RequestAuthentication to handle this access token passing at the edge.

在 Kubernetes 上，这种模式通常涉及一个 ingress 控制器，由它认证用户并把访问令牌注入到一个请求头里。你可以用 Traefik、带 oauth2-proxy 的 NGINX，或带 RequestAuthentication 的 Istio，在边缘处理这种访问令牌透传。

Figure 9-3 illustrates the complete flow with validation steps highlighted.

图 9-3 展示了完整流程，并高亮了各校验步骤。

Even though you are passing the user token for authorization, you should still use mutual TLS either directly or via a service mesh like Istio or Linkerd to encrypt traffic between the MCP server and upstream APIs, and verify that traffic is coming from authorized workloads.

即使你是透传用户令牌做授权，仍应使用双向 TLS（直接用，或通过 Istio、Linkerd 这类服务网格）来加密 MCP 服务器与上游 API 之间的流量，并校验流量来自已授权的工作负载。

Service Account Delegation
服务账号委派

The impersonation approach works well when user-level permissions matter and your identity infrastructure supports it, but when both the agent and the upstream services run in the same Kubernetes cluster and agent-level attribution is sufficient, a simpler alternative exists.

当用户级权限很重要、且你的身份基础设施支持时，模拟方案很好用；但当智能体和上游服务都运行在同一个 Kubernetes 集群内、且智能体级别的归属追溯就足够时，存在一个更简单的替代方案。

You rely on Kubernetes native workload identity instead of external token servers, which means fewer moving parts and less operational overhead. Every pod in Kubernetes already has a ServiceAccount, which can carry permissions through standard RBAC. The pattern leverages these built-in primitives to establish trust among the agent runtime, the MCP server, and upstream APIs without requiring a separate identity provider.

你依赖 Kubernetes 原生的工作负载身份，而不是外部令牌服务器，这意味着活动部件更少、运维开销更低。Kubernetes 里每个 pod 都已有一个 ServiceAccount，可以通过标准 RBAC 携带权限。该模式利用这些内建原语，在智能体运行时、MCP 服务器和上游 API 之间建立信任，而无需额外的身份提供者。

原书第 345 页

ServiceAccounts as workload identity
ServiceAccount 作为工作负载身份

A ServiceAccount in Kubernetes is a namespaced identity for pods. When you create a pod, Kubernetes assigns it a ServiceAccount—either one you specify explicitly or the default ServiceAccount in the pod's namespace. This identity is not tied to a human user but rather to a workload, which makes it ideal for service-to-service authentication.

Kubernetes 中的 ServiceAccount 是 pod 的一种命名空间级身份。创建 pod 时，Kubernetes 会给它分配一个 ServiceAccount——要么是你显式指定的，要么是 pod 所在命名空间里的默认 ServiceAccount。这种身份不绑定到人，而是绑定到工作负载，因此非常适合服务间认证。

Every ServiceAccount has an associated token that Kubernetes automatically mounts into the pod at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token. This token is a signed JSON Web Token (JWT) that contains claims identifying the ServiceAccount, including its name, namespace, and unique identifier. The Kubernetes API server signs these tokens with its own private key, and any component that trusts the API server can validate them.

每个 ServiceAccount 都有一个关联令牌，Kubernetes 会自动把它挂载到 pod 的 /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token 路径。这个令牌是一个已签名的 JSON Web Token（JWT），包含标识该 ServiceAccount 的声明（claim），包括其名称、命名空间和唯一标识符。Kubernetes API 服务器用自己的私钥给这些令牌签名，任何信任 API 服务器的组件都能校验它们。

Once this ServiceAccount exists, you can assign it to a pod by setting the serviceAccountName field in the Pod spec. When that pod starts, Kubernetes injects the ServiceAccount token as a file and keeps it refreshed automatically.

ServiceAccount 创建好后，你可以在 Pod spec 里设置 serviceAccountName 字段把它分配给 pod。pod 启动时，Kubernetes 会把 ServiceAccount 令牌作为文件注入，并自动保持刷新。

That token refresh is critical. ServiceAccount tokens are not static; Kubernetes rotates them periodically for security. Any code that reads the token must do so on every use rather than caching it in memory. Reading from the filesystem each time ensures you always have the current, valid token.

令牌刷新至关重要。ServiceAccount 令牌不是静态的；出于安全考虑 Kubernetes 会定期轮换它们。任何读取令牌的代码都必须在每次使用时读取，而不是在内存里缓存它。每次都从文件系统读取，才能确保你拿到的始终是当前有效令牌。

ServiceAccount tokens can be used in two contexts: inside the cluster and, with extra setup, outside the cluster. Within the cluster, ServiceAccount tokens are first-class citizens that the Kubernetes API server natively understands. When a pod calls the Kubernetes API and includes its ServiceAccount token in the Authorization header, the API server validates the signature, extracts the identity, and checks RBAC policies to decide whether the request is allowed.

ServiceAccount 令牌可在两种场景使用：集群内部，以及经过额外配置后的集群外部。在集群内，ServiceAccount 令牌是 Kubernetes API 服务器原生理解的一等公民。当 pod 调用 Kubernetes API 并在 Authorization 头里带上其 ServiceAccount 令牌时，API 服务器校验签名、提取身份，并检查 RBAC 策略来决定请求是否被允许。

ServiceAccount tokens can also be validated outside the cluster if the API server exposes an OIDC discovery endpoint. Most managed Kubernetes services like GKE, EKS, and AKS enable this by default. In this setup, the ServiceAccount token is a valid JWT that can be verified by any service with access to the cluster's OIDC public keys.

如果 API 服务器暴露了 OIDC 发现端点，ServiceAccount 令牌也能在集群外部被校验。GKE、EKS、AKS 等大多数托管 Kubernetes 服务默认开启此功能。在这种配置下，ServiceAccount 令牌是一个合法 JWT，任何能访问集群 OIDC 公钥的服务都能验证它。

The trade-off is added complexity: you must configure the external service to trust your cluster's OIDC issuer, retrieve the signing keys, and handle token validation logic. We cover external validation in more detail in “External validation via OIDC/JWT” on page 315.

代价是增加了复杂度：你必须配置外部服务信任你集群的 OIDC issuer、获取签名密钥，并处理令牌校验逻辑。外部校验在 315 页“通过 OIDC/JWT 做外部校验”一节中有更详细讨论。

Server identity versus agent identity
服务器身份与智能体身份

ServiceAccount delegation splits into two flows, depending on whose identity the upstream API sees. Both use ServiceAccount tokens, but they differ in which ServiceAccount token reaches the upstream API.

ServiceAccount 委派分成两种流程，取决于上游 API 看到的是谁的身份。两者都用 ServiceAccount 令牌，但区别在于最终到达上游 API 的是哪个 ServiceAccount 令牌。

原书第 346 页

In server identity, the MCP server uses its own ServiceAccount token when calling upstream APIs. The agent runtime's identity does not propagate; the upstream API enforces permissions based on the MCP server's identity. This is the simpler approach and works well when all agent runtimes using a given MCP server have uniform access to upstream resources.

在服务器身份方式中，MCP 服务器调用上游 API 时使用自己的 ServiceAccount 令牌。智能体运行时的身份不传播；上游 API 根据 MCP 服务器的身份来执行权限。这是更简单的方式，当使用某个 MCP 服务器的所有智能体运行时对上游资源都有一致访问权限时，效果很好。

In agent identity, the agent runtime sends its own ServiceAccount token to the MCP server, and the MCP server relays that token to the upstream API. The upstream API enforces permissions based on the agent runtime's identity, allowing different agent runtimes to have different access levels, even when calling the same MCP server.

在智能体身份方式中，智能体运行时把自己的 ServiceAccount 令牌发给 MCP 服务器，MCP 服务器再把该令牌转发给上游 API。上游 API 根据智能体运行时的身份执行权限，从而让不同智能体运行时即使调用同一个 MCP 服务器，也能有不同的访问级别。

Figure 9-4 illustrates both flows side by side.

图 9-4 并排展示了这两种流程。

The key decision is granularity. If every agent runtime should have the same permissions on a given MCP server's tools, use server identity. If different agent runtimes need different permission levels, use agent identity.

关键决策在于粒度。如果每个智能体运行时对某个 MCP 服务器的工具都应有相同权限，就用服务器身份；如果不同智能体运行时需要不同权限级别，就用智能体身份。

We will walk through each approach in detail, starting with the mechanics of creating ServiceAccounts and accessing their tokens.

我们将详细逐一介绍这两种方式，先从创建 ServiceAccount 并获取其令牌的机制讲起。

原书第 347 页

ServiceAccount usage
ServiceAccount 的使用

To grant ServiceAccounts appropriate permissions, you must define RBAC rules. For agent security, you should use use-case-specific custom API groups and resources rather than standard Kubernetes resources.

要给 ServiceAccount 授予合适权限，你必须定义 RBAC 规则。对于智能体安全，应使用面向具体用例的自定义 API 组和资源，而不是标准 Kubernetes 资源。

Here is the critical distinction: protecting access to the Kubernetes Service resource does not protect access to the service's endpoints. A ServiceAccount with get permissions on a service can only read the service metadata, not call the actual service. Instead, define application-specific resources that represent application-level permissions. Example 9-1 shows a basic RBAC setup involving Role, ServiceAccount, and RoleBinding declarations. For more information about how to set up RBAC within Kubernetes, refer to the Access Control pattern in Kubernetes Patterns.

这里有一个关键区别：保护对 Kubernetes Service 资源的访问，并不能保护对该 Service 端点的访问。对某个 service 有 get 权限的 ServiceAccount 只能读取该 service 的元数据，并不能调用真正的服务。相反，应定义代表应用级权限的应用专属资源。例 9-1 展示了一个基本的 RBAC 设置，包含 Role、ServiceAccount 和 RoleBinding 声明。关于如何在 Kubernetes 中设置 RBAC，参见《Kubernetes Patterns》中的访问控制模式。

Example 9-1. ServiceAccount with custom resource RBAC

apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: customer-support-mcp
  namespace: agents
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  namespace: data-platform
  name: customer-data-reader
rules:
- apiGroups: ["agents.example.com"]
  resources: ["customer-queries"]
  verbs: ["get", "list"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: customer-support-mcp-binding
  namespace: data-platform
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: customer-data-reader
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: customer-support-mcp
  namespace: agents
  • Use an agent-specific API group for your application domain.在你的应用领域中使用智能体专属的 API 组。
  • Define custom resource names representing application-level permissions, not Kubernetes resources.定义代表应用级权限的自定义资源名，而不是 Kubernetes 资源。
  • Bind the ServiceAccount from the agents namespace to this role that lives in the data-platform namespace.把 agents 命名空间里的 ServiceAccount 绑定到这个位于 data-platform 命名空间的 role。
原书第 348 页

Application-specific resources like the customer-queries resource in Example 9-1 (or similar resources such as medical-records, support-tickets, etc.) do not need to be registered as Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) at the Kubernetes API server. They exist only in RBAC rules and are used purely for authorization checks via SubjectAccessReview. This gives you fine-grained, application-specific permissions without the overhead of managing CRDs.

像例 9-1 中 customer-queries 这样的应用专属资源（或类似的 medical-records、support-tickets 等资源），不需要在 Kubernetes API 服务器上注册为自定义资源定义（CRD）。它们只存在于 RBAC 规则中，纯粹用于通过 SubjectAccessReview 做授权检查。这样你就能获得细粒度、应用专属的权限，而无需承担管理 CRD 的开销。

Kubernetes mounts the ServiceAccount token at a well-known path in every pod. Reading it is straightforward, but you must do it correctly to avoid using expired tokens.

Kubernetes 会在每个 pod 的一个众所周知路径挂载 ServiceAccount 令牌。读取它很简单，但必须读对，以免用到过期令牌。

The function in Example 9-2 reads the token each time it is called, ensuring that you always use the latest version.

例 9-2 中的函数在每次被调用时都重新读取令牌，确保你始终使用最新版本。

Example 9-2. Reading the ServiceAccount token correctly

from pathlib import Path

def get_serviceaccount_token() -> str:
    """Read the current ServiceAccount token from the filesystem."""
    token_path = Path("/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token")
    return token_path.read_text().strip()
  • Read the token on every call to ensure it is current—do not cache in memory, as Kubernetes refreshes this token automatically on the filesystem.每次调用都读取令牌以确保它是最新的——不要在内存中缓存，因为 Kubernetes 会在文件系统上自动刷新该令牌。

Making authenticated requests
发起已认证请求

In server identity, the MCP server uses its own ServiceAccount token when calling upstream APIs. For agent identity, the agent sends in its ServiceAccount token, and after validation the MCP copies this agent token over into the Authorization: HTTP header when it makes its request to any upstream API.

在服务器身份方式中，MCP 服务器调用上游 API 时使用自己的 ServiceAccount 令牌。在智能体身份方式中，智能体把自己的 ServiceAccount 令牌发进来，MCP 在通过校验后，会在向上游 API 发请求时把这个智能体令牌复制到 Authorization: HTTP 头里。

Example 9-3 shows how to send the token in an HTTP request when using service-level identity.

例 9-3 展示了在使用服务级身份时如何在 HTTP 请求中发送令牌。

原书第 349 页

Example 9-3. MCP server calling upstream with its own token

import httpx
from pathlib import Path

async def call_upstream_with_service_token(
    endpoint: str,
    payload: dict,
    user_id: str | None = None
) -> dict:
    """Call upstream API with the MCP server's ServiceAccount token."""
    sa_token = get_serviceaccount_token()

    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {sa_token}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }

    if user_id:
        payload["_audit_user_id"] = user_id

    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        response = await client.post(endpoint, json=payload, headers=headers)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()
  • Read the ServiceAccount token fresh from the filesystem with the function defined in Example 9-2.用例 9-2 中定义的函数从文件系统重新读取 ServiceAccount 令牌。
  • Include the token as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.把令牌作为 Bearer 令牌放进 Authorization 头。
  • Optionally include the end user's ID in the payload for audit purposes.可选地在 payload 中带上最终用户 ID，用于审计。

The upstream API sees the MCP server's identity and enforces permissions accordingly. If you need to track which end user triggered the request for audit purposes, you can include that information in the request payload or in a custom header like X-User-ID.

上游 API 看到的是 MCP 服务器的身份，并据此执行权限。如果出于审计需要追踪是哪个最终用户触发了请求，可以把该信息放进请求 payload，或放进类似 X-User-ID 的自定义头里。

This approach is simple and has minimal overhead, but all agent runtimes using this MCP server get the same level of access.

这种方式简单、开销极小，但使用该 MCP 服务器的所有智能体运行时都获得相同级别的访问权限。

Authentication via token validation
通过令牌校验做认证

When an MCP server receives a ServiceAccount token from an agent runtime when settling on agent identity, it must validate that token before trusting it. The same is true for any upstream API service that receives a request from an MCP server. Kubernetes provides the TokenReview API for exactly this purpose.

当采用智能体身份方式、MCP 服务器从智能体运行时收到一个 ServiceAccount 令牌时，它必须在信任该令牌之前先校验它。任何从 MCP 服务器收到请求的上游 API 服务也是如此。Kubernetes 专门提供了 TokenReview API 来做这件事。

原书第 350 页

The TokenReview API takes a token as input and returns whether it is valid, along with the identity it represents. Example 9-4 shows an example of how an MCP server can interact with the Kubernetes API to validate the token.

TokenReview API 接收一个令牌作为输入，返回它是否有效，以及它所代表的身份。例 9-4 展示了 MCP 服务器如何与 Kubernetes API 交互来校验令牌。

Example 9-4. Validating agent tokens with TokenReview

import httpx
from kubernetes import client, config

config.load_incluster_config()
auth_v1 = client.AuthenticationV1Api()

async def validate_agent_runtime_token(token: str) -> dict:
    """Validate agent runtime token using Kubernetes TokenReview API."""
    token_review = client.V1TokenReview(
        spec=client.V1TokenReviewSpec(token=token)
    )

    result = auth_v1.create_token_review(token_review)

    if not result.status.authenticated:
        raise ValueError("Token validation failed: not authenticated")

    username = result.status.user.username

    if not username.startswith("system:serviceaccount:agents:"):
        raise ValueError(f"Token from unauthorized namespace: {username}")

    return {
        "username": username,
        "uid": result.status.user.uid,
        "groups": result.status.user.groups
    }
  • Load the Kubernetes configuration from the in-cluster service account.从集群内 ServiceAccount 加载 Kubernetes 配置。
  • Create a TokenReview object with the token to validate.用待校验令牌创建一个 TokenReview 对象。
  • Submit the TokenReview to the Kubernetes API server. This is a synchronous call that will populate the status section of the TokenReview resource.把 TokenReview 提交给 Kubernetes API 服务器。这是一次同步调用，会填充 TokenReview 资源的 status 部分。
  • Check if the token is authenticated (valid signature and not expired).检查令牌是否已认证（签名有效且未过期）。
  • Extract the ServiceAccount username in the format system:serviceaccount:namespace:name.以 system:serviceaccount:namespace:name 的格式提取 ServiceAccount 用户名。
  • Enforce an allowlist policy: accept tokens only from the agents namespace.执行白名单策略：只接受来自 agents 命名空间的令牌。
原书第 351 页

This validation step is critical for security. By calling TokenReview, the MCP server confirms that the Kubernetes API server issued and signed this token.

这一步校验对安全性至关重要。通过调用 TokenReview，MCP 服务器确认该令牌确由 Kubernetes API 服务器签发并签名。

The allowlist check is a simple namespace-based filter for initial access control. It restricts which ServiceAccounts can use this MCP server, preventing pods from unrelated namespaces from calling your tools. For fine-grained authorization based on RBAC policies, use SubjectAccessReview, as described in the next section.

白名单检查是一个简单的、基于命名空间的过滤器，用于初始访问控制。它限制哪些 ServiceAccount 可以使用这个 MCP 服务器，防止来自不相关命名空间的 pod 调用你的工具。若要基于 RBAC 策略做细粒度授权，请使用下一节介绍的 SubjectAccessReview。

Token validation adds some small latency. You can cache validation results keyed by the token's hash with a short time-to-live (TTL) to reduce overhead, but ensure that the cache respects token expiration.

令牌校验会增加少量延迟。你可以用令牌哈希作为键、加一个短 TTL 来缓存校验结果以降低开销，但要确保缓存尊重令牌过期时间。

Authorization with SubjectAccessReview
用 SubjectAccessReview 做授权

Validating a token proves identity, but it does not tell you whether that identity has permission to perform a specific action. Kubernetes provides the SubjectAccessReview API for authorization checks.

校验令牌证明了身份，但它并没有告诉你该身份是否有权执行某个特定动作。Kubernetes 提供了 SubjectAccessReview API 来做授权检查。

SubjectAccessReview asks the Kubernetes API server: “Can this ServiceAccount perform this action on this resource?” It respects all RBAC policies, so you get a definitive answer based on the cluster's current state. Example 9-5 demonstrates how the API server can be queried for this information.

SubjectAccessReview 向 Kubernetes API 服务器提问：“这个 ServiceAccount 能否对这个资源执行这个动作？”它会遵守所有 RBAC 策略，因此你能基于集群当前状态得到一个明确答案。例 9-5 演示了如何向 API 服务器查询这些信息。

Example 9-5. Checking permissions with SubjectAccessReview

from kubernetes import client

authz_v1 = client.AuthorizationV1Api()

async def check_agent_permission(
    username: str,
    namespace: str,
    api_group: str,
    resource: str,
    verb: str
) -> bool:
    """Check if a ServiceAccount has permission to perform an action."""
    sar = client.V1SubjectAccessReview(
        spec=client.V1SubjectAccessReviewSpec(
            user=username,
            resource_attributes=client.V1ResourceAttributes(
                namespace=namespace,
                group=api_group,
                resource=resource,
                verb=verb,
            )
        )
    )

    result = authz_v1.create_subject_access_review(sar)
    return result.status.allowed
原书第 352 页
  • The ServiceAccount username from TokenReview, e.g., system:serviceaccount:agents:agent-runtime.来自 TokenReview 的 ServiceAccount 用户名，例如 system:serviceaccount:agents:agent-runtime。
  • The API group for custom resources, e.g., agents.example.com.自定义资源的 API 组，例如 agents.example.com。
  • The resource type, e.g., customer-queries.资源类型，例如 customer-queries。
  • The action being performed: get, list, create, update, delete, etc.正在执行的动作：get、list、create、update、delete 等。
  • Submit the SubjectAccessReview to the API server.把 SubjectAccessReview 提交给 API 服务器。

This approach lets you leverage the Kubernetes RBAC defined in Example 9-1 for application-level permissions without building a separate authorization system. The custom resources you check against (customer-queries, medical-records, etc.) do not need to exist as CRDs—they are virtual resources used purely for authorization decisions.

这种方式让你能利用例 9-1 中定义的 Kubernetes RBAC 来做应用级权限，而无需另建一套授权系统。你所检查的那些自定义资源（customer-queries、medical-records 等）并不需要作为 CRD 存在——它们是纯粹用于授权决策的虚拟资源。

External validation via OIDC/JWT
通过 OIDC/JWT 做外部校验

While the common case for ServiceAccount delegation is in-cluster usage, there are scenarios where you need to validate ServiceAccount tokens outside the cluster. For example, you might call a cloud provider API that supports OIDC federation, or you might have a hybrid architecture where some services run outside Kubernetes but still need to trust cluster identities.

虽然 ServiceAccount 委派的常见场景是集群内使用，但也存在需要在集群外部校验 ServiceAccount 令牌的情形。例如，你可能要调用一个支持 OIDC 联合的云厂商 API；或者你有混合架构，某些服务运行在 Kubernetes 之外，但仍需要信任集群身份。

Kubernetes can expose ServiceAccount tokens as OIDC-compliant JWTs that any OIDC-aware service can validate. This requires the cluster's API server to be configured with an OIDC issuer URL, which most managed Kubernetes services enable by default. Example 9-6 gives an example of how this validation of a ServiceAccount token can be achieved programmatically.

Kubernetes 可以把 ServiceAccount 令牌暴露为符合 OIDC 规范的 JWT，任何支持 OIDC 的服务都能校验它。这需要集群 API 服务器配置一个 OIDC issuer URL，大多数托管 Kubernetes 服务默认开启此项。例 9-6 给出了如何以编程方式完成这种 ServiceAccount 令牌校验的示例。

The cluster's API server exposes an OIDC discovery endpoint at <cluster-url>/.well-known/openid-configuration. This endpoint publishes the cluster's OIDC issuer URL and the location of the JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) used to sign tokens. An external service retrieves the JWKS, verifies the token's signature against those keys, and validates standard JWT claims, like expiration and audience.

集群的 API 服务器在 <cluster-url>/.well-known/openid-configuration 处暴露一个 OIDC 发现端点。该端点发布集群的 OIDC issuer URL，以及用于签名令牌的 JSON Web Key Set（JWKS）的位置。外部服务取回 JWKS，用这些密钥验证令牌签名，并校验标准 JWT 声明，如过期时间（exp）和受众（aud）。

原书第 353 页

Example 9-6. Validating ServiceAccount tokens externally via OIDC

import jwt
import httpx

async def validate_sa_token_externally(
    token: str,
    cluster_issuer: str,
    expected_audience: str
) -> dict:
    """Validate a Kubernetes ServiceAccount token using OIDC discovery."""
    discovery_url = f"{cluster_issuer}/.well-known/openid-configuration"

    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        discovery_resp = await client.get(discovery_url)
        discovery_resp.raise_for_status()
        discovery = discovery_resp.json()

        jwks_uri = discovery["jwks_uri"]
        jwks_resp = await client.get(jwks_uri)
        jwks_resp.raise_for_status()
        jwks = jwks_resp.json()

    signing_key = jwt.PyJWKClient(jwks_uri).get_signing_key_from_jwt(token)

    claims = jwt.decode(
        token,
        signing_key.key,
        algorithms=["RS256"],
        audience=expected_audience,
        issuer=cluster_issuer
    )

    return claims
  • Discover the OIDC configuration endpoint from the cluster's issuer URL.从集群的 issuer URL 发现 OIDC 配置端点。
  • Retrieve the JSON Web Key Set containing the public keys used to sign tokens.取回包含用于签名令牌公钥的 JSON Web Key Set。
  • Extract the correct signing key based on the token's key ID header.根据令牌的 key ID 头提取正确的签名密钥。
  • Validate the token's audience claim to ensure it is intended for your service.校验令牌的 audience 声明，确保它是发给你服务的。
  • Return the validated claims, including the ServiceAccount identity.返回已校验的声明，其中包括 ServiceAccount 身份。

For this to work, the cluster must be configured to include an audience claim in the ServiceAccount token it creates. By default, for all its minted service account tokens, a Kubernetes cluster uses its own issuer URL that is specified with the --service-account-issuer Kubernetes API server startup option as the audience.

要让这一切生效，集群必须配置成在它创建的 ServiceAccount 令牌中包含 audience 声明。默认情况下，Kubernetes 集群对其签发的所有 ServiceAccount 令牌，都把自己的 issuer URL（由 API 服务器启动参数 --service-account-issuer 指定）用作 audience。

原书第 354 页

You can overwrite the default with a comma-separated list of audience URLs with the --api-audiences option.

你可以用 --api-audiences 选项，传入逗号分隔的 audience URL 列表来覆盖默认值。

Example 9-7 shows how to specify the audience for an individual pod's ServiceAccount.

例 9-7 展示了如何为单个 pod 的 ServiceAccount 指定 audience。

Example 9-7. Declare the audience for a pod's ServiceAccount

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: demo
spec:
  serviceAccountName: my-sa
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: ghcr.io/example/app:latest
    volumeMounts:
    - name: oidc
      mountPath: /var/run/my-audience
      readOnly: true
  volumes:
  - name: oidc
    projected:
      sources:
      - serviceAccountToken:
          path: token
          audience: "https://my.service.example"
          expirationSeconds: 3600
  • Attached ServiceAccount.所挂载的 ServiceAccount。
  • Directory where to mount the service account tokens.挂载 ServiceAccount 令牌的目录。
  • List of service account tokens to mount, with different entries for multiple audiences.要挂载的 ServiceAccount 令牌列表，多个 audience 对应不同条目。
  • Name of the file that holds the token.存放令牌的文件名。
  • Audience added to the token JWT's aud: claim.添加到令牌 JWT 的 aud: 声明中的 audience。

If you need multiple audiences for calling different upstream services, either specify multiple serviceAccountToken entries in Example 9-7, each mounted in a different file, or leverage the TokenRequest API to mint a token targeted to multiple audiences.

如果你需要为调用不同上游服务设置多个 audience，可以在例 9-7 中指定多个 serviceAccountToken 条目（分别挂载到不同文件），或者利用 TokenRequest API 签发一个面向多个 audience 的令牌。

ServiceAccount delegation works well for workload-to-workload authentication within cluster boundaries, but it is fundamentally workload-based rather than user-based.

ServiceAccount 委派在集群边界内的工作负载间认证中表现良好，但它本质上是基于工作负载、而非基于用户的。

原书第 355 页

When you need to attribute actions to individual users across system boundaries, OAuth2 provides the dominant standard for delegated access. OAuth2 enables a user to grant an application permission to act on their behalf without sharing credentials, which is exactly what we need when an agent calls upstream APIs on behalf of a user. While we do not cover OAuth2 comprehensively in this book, understanding token exchange—a key OAuth2 extension—is critical for agentic security patterns. Token exchange allows you to trade one credential for another with a different scope and audience, enabling fine-grained delegation that preserves both user and agent identity.

当你需要跨系统边界把操作归属到具体用户时，OAuth2 提供了委派访问的主流标准。OAuth2 让用户可以授权一个应用代表自己行事，而无需共享凭据——这正是智能体代表用户调用上游 API 时所需要的。虽然本书不全面讨论 OAuth2，但理解令牌交换（OAuth2 的一个关键扩展）对智能体安全模式至关重要。令牌交换让你能把一种凭据换成另一种 scope 和 audience 不同的凭据，从而实现既保留用户身份又保留智能体身份的细粒度委派。

Sidebar: OAuth2 and the Model Context Protocol

The Model Context Protocol specification uses OAuth 2.1 for authorization when MCP servers require authenticated access. MCP servers act as OAuth Resource Servers, protecting their tools and resources with standard OAuth2 mechanisms. MCP implementations follow established OAuth2 specifications. MCP clients must implement OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata (RFC 8414) to discover authorization endpoints. Implementations should support Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591) to streamline setup. All clients must use Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) for authorization code flows.

For multiuser agentic systems requiring delegation semantics, RFC 8693 (Token Exchange) provides the mechanism to preserve both user and agent identities; we explore this pattern in detail in the next section.

For comprehensive coverage of OAuth2 security patterns and delegation flows, see Cloud Native Data Security with OAuth by Gary Archer et al. (O'Reilly).

MCP 规范在 MCP 服务器需要认证访问时使用 OAuth 2.1 做授权：MCP 服务器充当 OAuth 资源服务器，用标准 OAuth2 机制保护工具与资源。MCP 实现遵循既有 OAuth2 规范；MCP 客户端必须实现 OAuth 2.0 授权服务器元数据（RFC 8414）以发现授权端点，应支持动态客户端注册（RFC 7591）以简化配置，且所有客户端在授权码流中必须使用 PKCE。对需要委派语义的多用户智能体系统，RFC 8693（令牌交换）提供了同时保留用户与智能体身份的机制，下一节详述。OAuth2 安全模式与委派流的全面介绍见 Gary Archer 等著《Cloud Native Data Security with OAuth》（O'Reilly）。

Delegated Identity via OAuth2 Token Exchange
通过 OAuth2 令牌交换实现委派身份

The impersonation pattern preserves user context but introduces token lifetime complexity and scope explosion. The service account pattern simplifies operations but loses per-user attribution. OAuth2 Token Exchange (RFC 8693) provides both: a standards-based way to preserve user identity while making the calling service's identity visible to upstream systems.

模拟模式保留了用户上下文，但引入了令牌生命周期复杂度和 scope 膨胀；服务账号模式简化了运维，却失去了按用户的归属追溯。OAuth2 令牌交换（RFC 8693）两者兼得：它以标准化方式保留用户身份，同时让调用方服务的身份对上游系统可见。

Token exchange enables delegation semantics where the original user remains distinguishable from the service acting on their behalf. The exchanged token carries both identities in its claims: sub identifies the user on whose behalf work is being done (e.g., alice@example.com), while act identifies the current actor performing the work (e.g., customer-support-agent or customer-data-mcp-server). This dual-identity token allows services to enforce composite policies like “allow if the user has permission and the service is authorized for this operation.”

令牌交换实现了委派语义，让原始用户与代表其行事的服务可以区分开。交换所得的令牌在其声明中同时携带两种身份：sub 标识被代表行事的用户（例如 alice@example.com），act 标识当前执行工作的执行者（例如 customer-support-agent 或 customer-data-mcp-server）。这种双身份令牌让服务能够执行复合策略，比如“仅当用户有权限且该服务被授权执行此操作时才放行”。

原书第 356 页

Token exchange can occur at two points in an MCP workflow. First, the agent runtime can exchange a user's token for an MCP-server-targeted token that identifies both the user and the agent. Second, the MCP server can exchange its token for an upstream API-targeted token that identifies the user and the MCP server. The exchange mechanism is identical in both cases—only the actor identity in the act claim changes to reflect the current service performing the work.

令牌交换在 MCP 工作流中可以发生在两个位置。第一，智能体运行时可以把用户令牌换成一个面向 MCP 服务器的令牌，同时标识用户和智能体。第二，MCP 服务器可以把自己的令牌换成一个面向上游 API 的令牌，同时标识用户和 MCP 服务器。两种情况下交换机制完全相同——只是 act 声明中的执行者身份会变，以反映当前执行工作的服务。

This section focuses on the first scenario: the agent runtime exchanging a user token for an MCP server-targeted token. The pattern applies equally to MCP servers exchanging tokens for upstream API access.

本节聚焦第一种场景：智能体运行时把用户令牌换成面向 MCP 服务器的令牌。该模式同样适用于 MCP 服务器为访问上游 API 而交换令牌的情形。

The token exchange flow involves a token service—typically your identity provider or a dedicated security token service—as shown in Figure 9-5. The user authenticates and obtains an access token from the identity provider. The agent runtime calls the token exchange endpoint with the user's token as the subject_token and the MCP server as the audience. The token service validates the user's token and returns a delegated token. The agent runtime sends this delegated token to the MCP server, which can use it directly or exchange it again for upstream API calls.

令牌交换流程涉及一个令牌服务——通常是你的身份提供者或专门的安全令牌服务——如图 9-5 所示。用户认证后从身份提供者获得一个访问令牌。智能体运行时调用令牌交换端点，把用户令牌作为 subject_token，把 MCP 服务器作为 audience。令牌服务校验用户令牌并返回一个委派令牌。智能体运行时把这个委派令牌发给 MCP 服务器，后者可以直接使用它，或再次交换后用于调用上游 API。

Consider the healthcare example from “Agent Impersonation (Token Passthrough)” on page 306. When Nurse Alice queries patient records, the agent runtime exchanges her token for a delegated token that identifies both the medical-assistant agent and Nurse Alice. The upstream patient records API enforces a composite policy: “Allow access only if the agent is medical-assistant and Alice has access to this patient.” Both identities are preserved in a single, cryptographically signed token.

回顾 306 页“Agent 模拟（令牌透传）”中的医疗例子。当护士 Alice 查询病历时，智能体运行时把她的令牌换成一个同时标识医疗助手智能体和护士 Alice 的委派令牌。上游病历 API 执行复合策略：“仅当智能体是 medical-assistant 且 Alice 有权访问该病人时才放行。”两种身份都保留在同一个经密码学签名的令牌中。

原书第 357 页

This pattern is ideal when compliance requires knowing both who (the user) and what (the agent) accessed data, and when your identity provider supports token exchange. Modern identity platforms like Keycloak, Auth0, and Azure AD support RFC 8693. If you have multiple agents with different scopes, token exchange allows fine-grained scoping without creating separate user accounts for each agent.

当合规要求你同时知道是谁（用户）和什么（智能体）访问了数据、且你的身份提供者支持令牌交换时，这种模式非常理想。Keycloak、Auth0、Azure AD 等现代身份平台都支持 RFC 8693。如果你有多个 scope 不同的智能体，令牌交换让你能做细粒度 scope 划分，而不必为每个智能体单独创建用户账号。

On Kubernetes, implementing token exchange requires configuring your identity provider to support RFC 8693—for Keycloak, this is built in. The agent runtime performs the exchange before calling the MCP server, as demonstrated in Example 9-8.

在 Kubernetes 上实现令牌交换，需要配置你的身份提供者支持 RFC 8693——对 Keycloak 来说这是内建的。智能体运行时在调用 MCP 服务器之前执行交换，如例 9-8 所示。

Example 9-8. Agent runtime performs token exchange via RFC 8693

import httpx

async def exchange_token(
    user_token: str,
    agent_token: str,
    upstream_audience: str,
    token_endpoint: str
) -> str:
    """Exchange user token for delegated token via RFC 8693."""
    payload = {
        "grant_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange",
        "subject_token": user_token,
        "subject_token_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token",
        "requested_token_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token",
        "audience": upstream_audience,
        "actor_token": agent_token,
        "actor_token_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token",
    }

    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        response = await client.post(token_endpoint, data=payload)
        response.raise_for_status()
        token_data = response.json()
        return token_data["access_token"]
  • RFC 8693 grant type for token exchange requests.令牌交换请求使用的 RFC 8693 grant 类型。
  • The user's access token (the subject on whose behalf the agent acts).用户的访问令牌（智能体代表行事的主体）。
  • The MCP server or upstream API as audience, scoping the token to a specific service.把 MCP 服务器或上游 API 作为 audience，把令牌限定到特定服务。
  • The agent's access token representing the actor performing the exchange.代表执行交换动作的执行者的智能体访问令牌。
  • Per RFC 8693, actor_token_type is required when actor_token is present.按 RFC 8693，当存在 actor_token 时必须提供 actor_token_type。
  • The delegated token contains both identities: user in sub, and agent in act.委派令牌同时包含两种身份：用户在 sub 中，智能体在 act 中。
原书第 358 页

The MCP server receives the exchanged token from the agent runtime. It can either forward this dual-identity token directly to upstream APIs or perform its own token exchange to become the new actor in the act claim while preserving the user's identity in sub.

MCP 服务器从智能体运行时收到交换后的令牌。它既可以把这个双身份令牌直接转发给上游 API，也可以自己再做一次令牌交换，成为 act 声明中的新执行者，同时把用户身份保留在 sub 中。

The trade-off is additional complexity. You must operate a token exchange endpoint, handle token exchange errors, and cache exchanged tokens to avoid repeated exchange calls that add latency to every agent invocation.

代价是额外的复杂度。你必须运维一个令牌交换端点、处理令牌交换错误，并缓存交换后的令牌，以避免每次智能体调用都因重复交换而增加延迟。

For isolating tokens across contexts, you can construct cache keys from the tuple (user_subject, agent_identity, audience). When you receive an exchanged token, decode the JWT and extract the exp claim (expiration timestamp in Unix seconds). Set your cache time-to-live (TTL) to exp - current_time - safety_margin, where the safety margin accounts for clock skew and network latency—typically 30–60 seconds. Never cache a token with a TTL longer than its actual lifetime; a stale cached token will be rejected by the upstream API, forcing you to exchange again anyway, as well as wasting both the cache storage and the failed API call.

为了在不同上下文之间隔离令牌，可以用 (user_subject, agent_identity, audience) 这个元组构造缓存键。收到交换后的令牌时，解码 JWT 并提取 exp 声明（以 Unix 秒计的过期时间戳）。把缓存 TTL 设为 exp - current_time - safety_margin，其中安全余量用于补偿时钟偏移和网络延迟——通常取 30–60 秒。绝不要用比令牌实际寿命更长的 TTL 去缓存它；过期缓存的令牌会被上游 API 拒绝，到头来仍不得不重新交换，还白白浪费了缓存存储和那次失败的 API 调用。

If your cache implementation doesn't support per-entry TTLs (e.g., Redis with expiry per key), ensure that each cache entry is stored with its own expiration. For in-memory caches, consider storing {token, expires_at} and checking expiration on retrieval. Under high concurrency, multiple requests for the same (user, agent, audience) tuple might trigger parallel exchanges; use a cache-aside pattern with short-lived locks or accept occasional duplicate exchanges rather than introducing complex distributed locking.

如果你的缓存实现不支持每条目 TTL（例如 Redis 按 key 设置过期），请确保每个缓存条目都带自己的过期时间。对于内存缓存，可以考虑存储 {token, expires_at} 并在取出时检查过期。高并发下，对同一个 (user, agent, audience) 元组的多个请求可能触发并行交换；可以用带短锁的 cache-aside 模式，或者干脆容忍偶尔重复交换，而不要为此引入复杂的分布式锁。

Mutual TLS with SPIFFE/SPIRE (Zero-Trust)
用 SPIFFE/SPIRE 做双向 TLS（零信任）

Bearer tokens—whether OAuth2 access tokens, Kubernetes ServiceAccount tokens, or API keys—have a fundamental weakness: they can be stolen. If an attacker intercepts or exfiltrates a token, they can impersonate the legitimate caller until the token expires. The Secure Production Identity Framework for everyone (SPIFFE) and the SPIFFE Runtime Environment (SPIRE) solve this by binding identity cryptographically to the workload itself, making credentials impossible to steal without compromising the entire pod.

Bearer 令牌——无论是 OAuth2 访问令牌、Kubernetes ServiceAccount 令牌还是 API key——都有一个根本弱点：它们可能被盗。如果攻击者截获或窃取了一个令牌，就能冒充合法调用者，直到令牌过期。面向所有人的安全生产身份框架（SPIFFE）和 SPIFFE 运行时环境（SPIRE）通过把身份以密码学方式绑定到工作负载本身来解决这个问题，使凭据在不攻破整个 pod 的情况下不可能被窃取。

原书第 359 页

SPIFFE provides workload identity through certificates that are automatically issued, rotated, and verified. In the MCP context, this means that your agent runtime, MCP server, and upstream APIs can all authenticate each other using mutual TLS (mTLS) without managing any secrets. Every connection is cryptographically verified, and credentials have a default TTL of one hour (with rotation at 50% of TTL, so approximately every 30 minutes).

SPIFFE 通过自动签发、轮换和校验的证书来提供工作负载身份。在 MCP 场景下，这意味着你的智能体运行时、MCP 服务器和上游 API 都能使用双向 TLS（mTLS）互相认证，而无需管理任何 Secret。每条连接都经过密码学校验，凭据默认 TTL 为 1 小时（在 TTL 的 50% 时轮换，即大约每 30 分钟一次）。

How SPIFFE works for MCP
SPIFFE 在 MCP 中如何工作

SPIFFE assigns each workload a unique identity called a SPIFFE ID, formatted as a URI like spiffe://example.com/ns/agents/sa/customer-support. The workload proves its identity using a SPIFFE Verifiable Identity Document (SVID), which is an X.509 certificate containing the SPIFFE ID in the Subject Alternative Name (SAN) field. Think of the SPIFFE ID as the workload's name and the SVID as its cryptographically signed ID card.

SPIFFE 给每个工作负载分配一个唯一身份，称为 SPIFFE ID，格式是一个 URI，如 spiffe://example.com/ns/agents/sa/customer-support。工作负载用 SPIFFE 可验证身份文档（SVID）来证明身份，SVID 是一个 X.509 证书，在主体可选名（SAN）字段中包含该 SPIFFE ID。可以把 SPIFFE ID 想象成工作负载的名字，把 SVID 想象成它经密码学签名的身份证。

The SPIRE Server acts as the certificate authority, issuing SVIDs to workloads after verifying their identity through a process called attestation. On Kubernetes, attestation typically means validating the pod's ServiceAccount token against the Kubernetes API. The SPIRE Agent runs as a DaemonSet on every node, exposing a Workload API via Unix socket at /run/spire/sockets/agent.sock. Workloads mount this socket's host path as a volume and connect to retrieve their SVID—no network calls, no secrets to mount, just a local API that verifies the calling process.

SPIRE Server 充当证书颁发机构，在通过一个名为证明（attestation）的流程验证工作负载身份后，向其签发 SVID。在 Kubernetes 上，证明通常意味着对照 Kubernetes API 校验 pod 的 ServiceAccount 令牌。SPIRE Agent 以 DaemonSet 形式运行在每个节点上，通过 Unix socket 在 /run/spire/sockets/agent.sock 暴露一个 Workload API。工作负载把这个 socket 的宿主路径作为卷挂载进来并连接以获取自己的 SVID——没有网络调用，没有要挂载的 Secret，只有一个校验调用进程的本地 API。

Let's trace the full authentication chain from the agent runtime through the MCP server to an upstream API. Both workloads retrieve their SVIDs from the local SPIRE Agent as described earlier. With identities in place, mTLS secures each hop:

我们来追踪从智能体运行时、经 MCP 服务器到上游 API 的完整认证链。两个工作负载都如前所述从本地 SPIRE Agent 获取 SVID。身份就绪后，mTLS 保护每一跳：

  1. The agent runtime connects to the MCP server, presenting its SVID as the client certificate.智能体运行时连接到 MCP 服务器，出示自己的 SVID 作为客户端证书。
  2. The MCP server validates the agent's SPIFFE ID (e.g., spiffe://example.com/ns/agents/sa/agent-runtime), then responds with its own SVID as the server certificate.MCP 服务器校验智能体的 SPIFFE ID（例如 spiffe://example.com/ns/agents/sa/agent-runtime），然后以自己的 SVID 作为服务器证书回应。
  3. The agent runtime validates the MCP server's SPIFFE ID in return, completing the mutual authentication.智能体运行时反过来校验 MCP 服务器的 SPIFFE ID，完成双向认证。
  4. When the MCP server calls the upstream API, the same handshake repeats: both sides present and validate SVIDs before any data flows.当 MCP 服务器调用上游 API 时，同样的握手重复一遍：双方在任何数据流动之前都出示并校验 SVID。

Figure 9-6 illustrates this architecture.

图 9-6 展示了这一架构。

Deploying SPIRE on Kubernetes
在 Kubernetes 上部署 SPIRE

SPIRE requires two components: a SPIRE Server (deployed as a StatefulSet) and SPIRE Agents. Example 9-9 shows an example of an SPIRE Agent deployed as DaemonSet. The server maintains the trust root and issues SVIDs. The agents run on every node, providing local access to the Workload API.

SPIRE 需要两个组件：一个 SPIRE Server（以 StatefulSet 部署）和若干 SPIRE Agent。例 9-9 展示了一个以 DaemonSet 部署的 SPIRE Agent。服务器维护信任根并签发 SVID。Agent 运行在每个节点上，提供对 Workload API 的本地访问。

Example 9-9. SPIRE Agent DaemonSet

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: spire-agent
  namespace: spire
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: spire-agent
  template:
    spec:
      hostPID: true
      serviceAccountName: spire-agent
      containers:
      - name: spire-agent
        image: ghcr.io/spiffe/spire-agent
        volumeMounts:
        - name: spire-socket
          mountPath: /run/spire/sockets
        - name: spire-token
          mountPath: /var/run/secrets/tokens
      volumes:
      - name: spire-socket
        hostPath:
          path: /run/spire/sockets
          type: DirectoryOrCreate
      - name: spire-token
        projected:
          sources:
          - serviceAccountToken:
              path: spire-agent
              audience: spire-server

  • Required for cgroup-based workload attestation (the agent needs to read /proc to identify calling processes).基于 cgroup 的工作负载证明所需（Agent 需要读取 /proc 来识别调用进程）。
  • Unix socket where workloads retrieve SVIDs.工作负载获取 SVID 的 Unix socket。
  • ServiceAccount token for agent-to-server authentication.用于 Agent 到服务器认证的 ServiceAccount 令牌。

After deploying SPIRE, you register each workload by mapping Kubernetes selectors on namespace and ServiceAccount name to a SPIFFE ID, as shown in Example 9-10. This creates a registration entry telling SPIRE which identity to issue to which pods.

部署 SPIRE 后，你通过把基于命名空间和 ServiceAccount 名的 Kubernetes 选择器映射到一个 SPIFFE ID 来注册每个工作负载，如例 9-10 所示。这会创建一条注册条目，告诉 SPIRE 该给哪些 pod 签发哪个身份。

Example 9-10. Registering the MCP server workload

kubectl exec -n spire spire-server-0 -- \
  /opt/spire/bin/spire-server entry create \
  -spiffeID spiffe://example.com/ns/mcp/sa/customer-support \
  -parentID spiffe://example.com/spire-agent \
  -selector k8s:ns:mcp \
  -selector k8s:sa:customer-support
  • SPIFFE ID assigned to matching workloads.分配给匹配工作负载的 SPIFFE ID。
  • Selectors match pods in namespace mcp with ServiceAccount customer-support.选择器匹配 mcp 命名空间中、ServiceAccount 为 customer-support 的 pod。

For production clusters with hundreds or thousands of workloads, manual registration doesn't scale. The SPIRE Controller Manager automates this by watching Kubernetes resources and creating registration entries automatically. Install it via Helm alongside the SPIRE Server, and it will register new pods as they appear based on annotations or ClusterSPIFFEID custom resources.

对于有数百到数千个工作负载的生产集群，手动注册无法扩展。SPIRE Controller Manager 通过监听 Kubernetes 资源并自动创建注册条目来自动化这件事。用 Helm 把它和 SPIRE Server 一起装上，它就会根据注解或 ClusterSPIFFEID 自定义资源，在新 pod 出现时自动注册它们。

Using SPIFFE
使用 SPIFFE

Your MCP server retrieves its SVID from the SPIRE Agent and uses it to establish mTLS connections. As shown in Example 9-11, the py-spiffe library simplifies this if you are coding in Python.

你的 MCP 服务器从 SPIRE Agent 获取 SVID，并用它建立 mTLS 连接。如例 9-11 所示，如果你用 Python 编码，py-spiffe 库能简化这件事。

Example 9-11. MCP server using SPIFFE for mTLS

import ssl
import tempfile
import httpx
from spiffe import WorkloadApiClient
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization

def svid_to_pem_files(svid):
    """Write SVID certificate chain and private key to temporary PEM files."""
    ...
    return cert_path, key_path

with WorkloadApiClient() as client:
    x509_ctx = client.fetch_x509_context()
    svid = x509_ctx.default_svid
    cert_path, key_path = svid_to_pem_files(svid)

    ssl_context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT)
    ssl_context.load_cert_chain(certfile=cert_path, keyfile=key_path)

    for bundle in x509_ctx.x509_bundle_set.bundles:
        for ca_cert in bundle.x509_authorities:
            ssl_context.load_verify_locations(
                cadata=ca_cert.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM).decode()
            )

    async with httpx.AsyncClient(verify=ssl_context) as http_client:
        response = await http_client.post(
            "https://api.example.com/endpoint",
            json={"query": "list tickets"}
        )
原书第 362 页
  • Helper function to serialize SVID credentials to temporary PEM files for use with Python's ssl module.辅助函数，把 SVID 凭据序列化为临时 PEM 文件，供 Python 的 ssl 模块使用。
  • Code block for storing the svid.cert_chain and svid.private_key into files is intentionally omitted.把 svid.cert_chain 和 svid.private_key 存入文件的代码块有意省略。
  • Retrieves an X.509 context (SVID and trust bundles) from the local SPIRE Agent.从本地 SPIRE Agent 获取 X.509 上下文（SVID 和信任 bundle）。
  • Loads the SVID certificate chain and private key from the temporary files.从临时文件加载 SVID 证书链和私钥。
  • Iterates over trust bundles and loads each CA certificate for server verification.遍历信任 bundle，加载每个 CA 证书用于服务器校验。
  • The httpx library uses mTLS so the upstream API can validate the MCP server's SPIFFE ID.httpx 库使用 mTLS，以便上游 API 能校验 MCP 服务器的 SPIFFE ID。

The SPIRE Agent handles SVID rotation automatically, typically every hour. The WorkloadApiClient library manages this rotation in the background: when your certificate nears expiration, it fetches a new one transparently. You do not need to reload or restart your application.

SPIRE Agent 自动处理 SVID 轮换，通常每小时一次。WorkloadApiClient 库在后台管理这种轮换：当你的证书接近过期时，它透明地获取新证书。你无需重载或重启应用。

When validating inbound connections, extract the SPIFFE ID from the client certificate and check it against an allowlist, as demonstrated in Example 9-12.

校验入站连接时，从客户端证书中提取 SPIFFE ID，并对照白名单检查，如例 9-12 所示。

原书第 363 页

Example 9-12. Validating client SPIFFE ID in the MCP server

from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.x509.oid import ExtensionOID

ssl_info = request.transport.get_extra_info('ssl_object')
if not ssl_info:
    raise PermissionDenied("TLS connection required")

client_cert_der = ssl_info.getpeercert(binary_form=True)
if not client_cert_der:
    raise PermissionDenied("Client certificate required")

cert = x509.load_der_x509_certificate(client_cert_der)
san_ext = cert.extensions.get_extension_for_oid(ExtensionOID.SUBJECT_ALTERNATIVE_NAME)
spiffe_ids = [
    name.value for name in san_ext.value
    if isinstance(name, x509.UniformResourceIdentifier)
    and name.value.startswith("spiffe://")
]

if not spiffe_ids:
    raise PermissionDenied("No SPIFFE ID in client certificate")

client_spiffe_id = spiffe_ids[0]
allowed_ids = ["spiffe://example.com/ns/agents/sa/agent-runtime"]
if client_spiffe_id not in allowed_ids:
    raise PermissionDenied(f"Unknown SPIFFE ID: {client_spiffe_id}")
  • Extracts the DER-encoded client certificate from a TLS connection.从 TLS 连接中提取 DER 编码的客户端证书。
  • Parses the certificate and extracts SPIFFE IDs from the Subject Alternative Name (SAN) extension.解析证书，并从主体可选名（SAN）扩展中提取 SPIFFE ID。
  • Compares the full SPIFFE ID URI against the allowlist.把完整 SPIFFE ID URI 与白名单比对。

SPIFFE authenticates workloads (pods and containers), not end users. When you need user-level attribution—which customer support agent issued a ticket, for example—you can combine SPIFFE for workload authentication with the user identity in request headers or JWT claims. The agent runtime establishes mTLS via its SPIFFE ID, like spiffe://example.com/ns/agents/sa/agent-runtime, while passing user context in an X-User-ID header. The MCP server validates the SPIFFE ID to trust the workload, then uses the user ID for authorization and audit logs.

SPIFFE 认证的是工作负载（pod 和容器），而不是最终用户。当你需要用户级归属——例如是哪个客服智能体开了一张工单——时，可以把用于工作负载认证的 SPIFFE 与请求头或 JWT 声明中的用户身份结合起来。智能体运行时通过其 SPIFFE ID（如 spiffe://example.com/ns/agents/sa/agent-runtime）建立 mTLS，同时在 X-User-ID 头中传递用户上下文。MCP 服务器校验 SPIFFE ID 以信任该工作负载，然后用用户 ID 做授权和审计日志。

SPIFFE eliminates secret sprawl entirely—no API keys, tokens, or client secrets to manage. SPIRE handles credential issuance and automatic hourly rotation without application restarts. If you already use a service mesh, you can configure them to use SPIRE as the certificate authority, unifying workload identity across your platform without managing separate CAs.

SPIFFE 彻底消除了 Secret 蔓延——无需管理 API key、令牌或客户端 Secret。SPIRE 负责凭据签发和每小时自动轮换，无需重启应用。如果你已经在用服务网格，可以配置它们把 SPIRE 用作证书颁发机构，从而在整个平台上统一工作负载身份，而无需管理单独的 CA。

原书第 364 页

The operational setup is significant though. The SPIRE Server acts as your root of trust and should be treated as critical infrastructure. Production deployments run it in a dedicated namespace with strict NetworkPolicies, restrict RBAC permissions to a small admin team, and maintain regular backups of its persistent volume. SPIRE upgrades require careful handling, SVID issuance patterns should be monitored for anomalies, and alerts should be configured for unexpected SPIFFE IDs or failed attestation attempts.

不过，运维上的设置相当重。SPIRE Server 充当你的信任根，应被视为关键基础设施。生产部署应把它跑在专用命名空间里，配严格的 NetworkPolicy，把 RBAC 权限收敛到一小支管理员团队，并对其持久卷做定期备份。SPIRE 升级需要谨慎处理；应监控 SVID 签发模式以发现异常，并为意外的 SPIFFE ID 或失败的证明尝试配置告警。

The learning curve is steeper than bearer tokens, but SPIFFE/SPIRE provides workload identity that cannot be exfiltrated and credentials that rotate automatically, eliminating credential theft attacks entirely.

它的学习曲线比 bearer 令牌陡峭，但 SPIFFE/SPIRE 提供了无法被窃取的工作负载身份和自动轮换的凭据，彻底消除了凭据被盗攻击。

Sidebar: MCP Gateways

An alternative to implementing security patterns in every MCP server is deploying an MCP gateway as a centralized policy enforcement point. MCP gateways act as reverse proxies that sit between agent runtimes and MCP servers, intercepting requests to enforce authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging in a single location.

Several MCP gateway implementations emerged in 2025, but this is just the beginning. Microsoft's MCP Gateway provides session-aware stateful routing and Kubernetes lifecycle management with OAuth 2.0 and RBAC support. IBM's ContextForge offers federation across multiple gateway deployments, virtual server composition (bundling multiple MCP servers into one logical endpoint), and protocol translation among stdio, SSE, and HTTP transports. Envoy AI Gateway extends Envoy's architecture with an MCP proxy that handles JSON-RPC multiplexing and integrates with Envoy's security extensions. Solo.io's agentgateway provides automated MCP server discovery; multiplexing across tool servers into a single endpoint; and centralized observability through integrated metrics, logging, and tracing. This space is very young, so watch out for more offerings when you read this.

MCP gateways centralize capabilities that would otherwise be scattered across individual servers. On the authentication and authorization front, gateways handle SSO integration with identity providers like Keycloak and enforce fine-grained access control using policy engines like OPA or Cedar.

The trade-offs are operational complexity and latency. The gateway becomes a single point of failure requiring high availability deployment with multiple replicas and load balancing. Every request incurs additional latency, depending on policy complexity. For deployments with many MCP servers, multitenant environments, or complex authorization requirements, the operational benefits outweigh these costs. For smaller deployments, embedding security logic directly in MCP servers or relying on a service mesh may be more appropriate.

与其在每个 MCP 服务器里实现一遍安全模式，不如部署一个 MCP 网关作为集中式策略执行点：它作为反向代理位于智能体运行时与 MCP 服务器之间，在一处拦截请求并统一执行认证、授权、限流和审计日志。2025 年出现了若干 MCP 网关实现，但这只是开始：微软 MCP Gateway 提供会话感知的有状态路由与 Kubernetes 生命周期管理，支持 OAuth 2.0 和 RBAC；IBM ContextForge 提供跨多个网关部署的联合、虚拟服务器组合（把多个 MCP 服务器打包成一个逻辑端点）以及 stdio/SSE/HTTP 传输间的协议转换；Envoy AI Gateway 为 Envoy 架构扩展了一个处理 JSON-RPC 多路复用的 MCP 代理，并集成 Envoy 安全扩展；Solo.io 的 agentgateway 提供自动 MCP 服务器发现、把多个工具服务器多路复用到单端点，以及通过集成指标、日志和追踪实现的集中可观测性。该领域非常新，你读到时可能已有更多产品。网关把原本散落在各服务器的能力集中起来：在认证授权侧，网关处理与 Keycloak 等身份提供者的 SSO 集成，并用 OPA、Cedar 等策略引擎执行细粒度访问控制。代价是运维复杂度与延迟：网关成为单点故障，需要多副本加高可用和负载均衡部署；每个请求都按策略复杂度增加额外延迟。对 MCP 服务器众多、多租户或授权复杂的部署，运维收益大于这些成本；对较小部署，直接把安全逻辑嵌进 MCP 服务器或依赖服务网格可能更合适。

Choosing the right security pattern
选择合适的安全模式

No single pattern fits all scenarios. The right choice depends on your organization's security maturity, compliance requirements, existing infrastructure, and operational capacity. Each pattern we explored—agent impersonation, service account delegation, token exchange, and SPIFFE/SPIRE—makes different trade-offs among simplicity, security depth, and operational overhead. Review the individual pattern sections to understand the specific benefits and costs of each approach.

没有一种模式能适合所有场景。正确选择取决于你组织的安全成熟度、合规要求、现有基础设施和运维能力。我们探讨的每种模式——智能体模拟、服务账号委派、令牌交换和 SPIFFE/SPIRE——都在简洁性、安全深度和运维开销之间做了不同权衡。请回顾各模式小节，了解每种方式的具体收益与代价。

In practice, production systems rarely use a single pattern in isolation. Layering multiple patterns creates defense in depth while preserving flexibility. A common approach combines SPIFFE/SPIRE for workload-to-workload mTLS, with user identity passed in request metadata. The agent runtime establishes an encrypted, mutually authenticated channel using its SPIFFE ID, while including the user's identity in an X-User-ID header or as a claim in an exchanged token. The MCP server validates the SPIFFE ID to trust the calling workload, then extracts the user identity for authorization decisions and audit logging. This gives you the security benefits of SPIFFE—cryptographic workload identity, automatic rotation, and protection against credential theft—while maintaining per-user attribution for compliance and debugging.

实际中，生产系统很少孤立使用单一模式。把多种模式叠加起来既能形成深度防御，又保留灵活性。一种常见做法是：用 SPIFFE/SPIRE 做工作负载间 mTLS，同时在请求元数据中传递用户身份。智能体运行时用自己的 SPIFFE ID 建立一条加密、双向认证的通道，同时在 X-User-ID 头或交换令牌的声明中带上用户身份。MCP 服务器校验 SPIFFE ID 以信任调用方工作负载，然后提取用户身份用于授权决策和审计日志。这样你既获得了 SPIFFE 的安全收益——密码学工作负载身份、自动轮换、防凭据盗窃——又保留了按用户的归属追溯，以满足合规和排障需要。

You can further refine authorization by combining workload and user identities in policy decisions. A policy engine like Open Policy Agent can enforce rules like “allow this request only if the calling workload is customer-support-mcp AND the user has access to the requested customer record.” This composite authorization prevents compromised workloads from accessing arbitrary data and ensures that both the service and the user must be authorized.

你还可以在策略决策中结合工作负载身份和用户身份，进一步细化授权。像 Open Policy Agent 这样的策略引擎可以执行规则，例如“仅当调用方工作负载是 customer-support-mcp 且用户有权访问所请求的客户记录时才放行”。这种复合授权能防止被攻破的工作负载访问任意数据，并确保服务和用户都必须被授权。

When working with external third-party agents that call your APIs, additional considerations emerge. Token exchange requires Identity Provider federation so your identity provider can validate tokens issued by external organizations. SPIFFE/SPIRE requires trust bundle federation between your SPIRE deployment and the external party's SPIRE infrastructure. Both approaches work, but federation setup adds operational complexity that internal-only deployments avoid.

当与调用你 API 的外部第三方智能体打交道时，会出现额外考量。令牌交换需要身份提供者联合，让你的身份提供者能校验外部组织签发的令牌。SPIFFE/SPIRE 则需要在你的 SPIRE 部署与外部方的 SPIRE 基础设施之间做信任 bundle 联合。两种方式都可行，但联合配置增加了运维复杂度，而纯内部部署可以避免这一点。

MCP solves the challenge of connecting agents to external tools and data sources, but production agentic systems face another integration problem. When you have multiple specialized agents that need to collaborate, how do they communicate? Most frameworks invent their own coordination mechanisms, creating the same fragmentation problem that MCP solved for tools. The A2A protocol emerged to standardize this cross-agent coordination.

MCP 解决了把智能体连接到外部工具和数据源的挑战，但生产级智能体系统还面临另一个集成问题。当你有多个需要协作的专业智能体时，它们如何通信？大多数框架都发明自己的协调机制，造成了 MCP 曾为工具解决过的那种碎片化问题。A2A 协议应运而生，把这种跨智能体协调标准化。
